reason: The cited lines show the handler sends a fixed browser navigation socket message and, if snapshotting is enabled, returns the current page URL, title, and browser snapshot. This does not show arbitrary host code execution, nor delivery of agent-supplied data to an attacker-readable destination. It does show browser page data being returned into the agent context, which can include non-public user/session content. The returned URL/title/page snapshot are also web/page-controlled content, so they are untrusted.
